reviews.conclusion: End exit into black/dirt credits with Minecraft logo, followed by overworld respawn. Credits transition bounds 10.5-11.0 s contain the 10.517 s deficit. This is post-finish credits context, not an unexplained in-run clock deficit.

Two visible pause/settings visits span combined 1.75-2.75 s, compatible with 2.633 s deficit. Resized eye-view phase has uncertain pause state. Loading screen appears before the flag bracket, so is not counted toward explaining this bracket.
Terrain loading is followed by two visible pause/settings visits spanning approximately 2.0-3.0 s in total, compatible with the 2.3 s deficit.

End-entry terrain loading is immediately followed by approximately 1.25-1.75 s of Japanese options/video-settings screens, compatible with the -1.5167 s deficit. These are visually recognizable menu layouts; the assessment does not depend on OCR translation.
Options/video-settings sequence spans transition bounds 1.25-1.75 s, compatible with 1.433 s deficit. No native-frame timing closure claimed.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
